Update：服務似乎在半小時左右後陸續恢復，實際情況可能因人而異。

You are not the only one affected. Claude、ChatGPT/Codex 以及 Grok 現正出現疑似大規模故障，影響眾多用戶。

The outage comes as OpenAI is hyping up its GPT-6 Astra announcement.

ChatGPT 嘅網頁版、手機版及桌面版均受波及，Claude 似乎同樣出現故障。SpaceXAI 亦已證實 Grok 服務出現問題。

The service interruption comes as OpenAI is reportedly set to announce its new-generation large model Astra as early as today. The new model is expected to upgrade OpenAI's model from GPT-5.6 to GPT-6.

If there is further news, we will update the report.

充分發揮你的 Apple 產品效能
